race.comment: ZAMBALES (9) is the clear starting point in the race on resumption. Arguably the best maiden in the country, he's run fourth in a Blue Diamond, second against the bias in a VRC Sires, fifth in an ATC Sires and fourth in a Champagne Stakes as a 2yo. He's won a jumpout leading in and while this looks a handy race it should take a good one to keep him a maiden. ZOEHRER (10) is a colt by Toronado on debut for the Busuttin & Young stable. He's been jumping out very nicely on a few occasions, Williams on from a nice draw can see him measure up. INNER GOLD (3) resumes and can be an improver this time around. LEGALITY (4) is a Toronado colt for the Freedman yard who book Zahra off some solid jumpouts.
